---
title: "What top speed results once propeller thrust lapse is calibrated?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 220.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 88.0      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Solved performance with calibrated APC 6x4.5E manufacturer polar
top_new = find_top_speed_apc(airplane, mass=MASS_AUW, v_oc=11.1)
v_top_kmh = top_new["v_top_kmh"]
v_top_ms = top_new["v_top"]
rpm_new = top_new["rpm"]
j_top = top_new["J"]
i_new = top_new["current"]

# Baseline solved performance from initial empirical fit
top_old = find_top_speed(airplane, mass=MASS_AUW, v_oc=11.1)
v_old_kmh = top_old["v_top_kmh"]
rpm_old = top_old["rpm"]
v_pitch_old_kmh = (rpm_old / 60.0) * (4.5 * 0.0254) * 3.6

# Pitch speed comparison
prop_p_in = 4.5
v_pitch_new_kmh = (rpm_new / 60.0) * (prop_p_in * 0.0254) * 3.6
pitch_ratio_pct = (v_top_kmh / v_pitch_new_kmh) * 100
speed_diff_kmh = v_top_kmh - v_old_kmh

# Airspeed sweep for visual comparison
v_sweep = np.linspace(25.0, 48.0, 24)
drag_sweep = np.array([level_flight_drag(airplane, v, mass=MASS_AUW) for v in v_sweep])
thrust_old_sweep = np.array([solve_propulsion_thrust(v, v_oc=11.1)["thrust"] for v in v_sweep])
thrust_new_sweep = np.array([solve_propulsion_thrust_apc(v, v_oc=11.1)["thrust"] for v in v_sweep])
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{v_top_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.hero-value}
[Level-flight top speed with calibrated APC 6x4.5E propeller polar]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** No; the initial fit lapsed prematurely to zero thrust near pitch speed and underpredicted torque, spinning the motor to [`{python} f"{rpm_old:.0f} RPM"`]{.key}. With calibrated APC 6x4.5E data, motor torque loads the powertrain to [`{python} f"{rpm_new:.0f} RPM"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{i_new:.1f} A"`]{.key}), shifting pitch speed from [`{python} f"{v_pitch_old_kmh:.0f} km/h"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{v_pitch_new_kmh:.0f} km/h"`]{.key}. Because cambered blades generate positive thrust past geometric pitch up to zero-lift advance ratio, top speed sits at [`{python} f"{pitch_ratio_pct:.0f}%"`]{.key} of pitch speed ($J =$ [`{python} f"{j_top:.2f}"`]{.key}), reaching [`{python} f"{v_top_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.key}—shifting the [initial estimate](2026-10-02-02-what-level-flight-top-speed-does-the-3s-powertrain-reach.qmd) by [`{python} f"{speed_diff_kmh:+.1f} km/h"`]{.key} (@fig-thrust-comparison).

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **propeller polar: APC 6x4.5E**, manufacturer data replaces empirical fit.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-thrust-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Level-flight drag and available thrust for the initial empirical fit versus the calibrated APC polar."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 4.0))

v_sweep_kmh = v_sweep * 3.6
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, drag_sweep, "k-", lw=2, label="Level flight drag ($L = W$)")
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, thrust_old_sweep, "r--", lw=1.8, label=f"Initial fit ($V_{{\\rm top}} = {v_old_kmh:.1f}$ km/h)")
ax.plot(v_sweep_kmh, thrust_new_sweep, "b-", lw=2, label=f"Calibrated APC ($V_{{\\rm top}} = {v_top_kmh:.1f}$ km/h)")

ax.axvline(v_pitch_new_kmh, color="b", linestyle=":", lw=1.2, label=f"Calibrated pitch speed ({v_pitch_new_kmh:.0f} km/h)")
ax.plot(v_top_kmh, top_new["thrust"], "bo", ms=6)
ax.plot(v_old_kmh, top_old["thrust"], "ro", ms=6)

ax.set_xlabel("Airspeed [km/h]")
ax.set_ylabel("Force [N]")
ax.set_xlim(90, 175)
ax.set_ylim(0, 4.5)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
